notes: 0.3.46：修掉「同步过一次之后，新建会话直接失败」。现场是会话日志报 corrupt Zstandard session log: invalid frame magic at byte 186，一个历史会话坏掉后整个会话库校验失败，所以连新会话都建不出来。根因：DSH 写的首帧带 4 字节 zstd content checksum（帧头描述符 FHD 的 bit2），helper 用二分找「最小可解前缀」时，解压器对缺了这 4 字节的前缀照样成功，于是帧尾算短 4 字节；写回时旧 checksum 被当成正文，186..189 永久残留，DSH 读第二帧就撞上垃圾。修法：① firstFrameEnd 按 FHD bit2 补 4 字节，再以「下一帧帧头」校正；② 首帧改为整段解压文本替换 cwd 后重压（原来只重压 header 一行，首帧有追加行会丢）；③ 写回前自检（cwd 生效 + 新首帧末尾必须是下一帧帧头），任一不过不落盘；④ 对历史坏文件的残留尾巴自动丢掉自愈。实测：本机 17 个会话日志扫出坏 1 个，删空洞后 423→419 字节、首帧 cwd 与第 2 帧都完好；隔离环境用真实 checksum 多帧样本验证改 cwd 后帧头 0/169/352/451/531 全部可解，幂等复跑 alreadyOk=1，喂入带空洞的坏文件一次修好。README 补了这条踩坑与实测记录。
notesEn: 0.3.46: fixes "creating a session fails outright after one sync". The log read `corrupt Zstandard session log: invalid frame magic at byte 186`; one corrupt historical session made the whole session store fail validation, so even a new session could not be created. Root cause: the first frame DSH writes carries a 4-byte zstd content checksum (frame header descriptor FHD bit2), and the decompressor succeeds on the prefix with that checksum trimmed, so the binary search for the shortest decodable prefix ended 4 bytes early; the rewrite then kept the old checksum as body text (bytes 186..189), and DSH hit that garbage when reading the second frame. Fixes: (1) firstFrameEnd adds 4 bytes per FHD bit2 and corrects against the next frame magic; (2) the first frame is rebuilt from the whole decompressed text with only the cwd value replaced (it used to recompress just the header line); (3) self-check before writing (cwd applied and the new first frame is followed by a frame magic), nothing is written if either fails; (4) leftover tails in already-broken files are dropped (self-healing). Measured: 1 of 17 session logs was broken; after dropping the hole 423 -> 419 bytes with header cwd and the second frame intact; an isolated run with a real checksum multi-frame sample decoded frames at 0/169/352/451/531 after the cwd rewrite, an idempotent rerun reported alreadyOk=1, and a file with the hole was repaired in one pass. The README gained this pitfall and the test log.
